QuestInfo.name: Fairy Fury
QuestInfo.0: What's Wing the Fairy in such a twist about?
QuestInfo.2: You helped Wing the Fairy with his Lupin problem. Return to Grendel the Really Old.

0.0: Buzz off! Scram! Get outta here! I don't feel like talking to your dumb face!\r\n#L0##bCalm yourself, friend. What has you so upset?#l\n#k
0.1: Don't you 'friend' me! You're just like those stupid monkeys!\r\n#L0##bWhat are these 'monkeys' of which you speak?#l\n#k
0.2: If you really gotta know, I went out to play with the Lupins and they threw a bunch of bananas at me! Those bananas are deadly! I wish I could teach those idiot apes a lesson.

yes.0: You're gonna help? Really? Beat up 50 of 'em, and I'll feel way better!

no.0: If you aren't gonna help, then SCRAM!

1.0: You beat 'em all up, right?\r\n#L0##bI promise you, those Lupins rue the day they crossed Luminous.#l\n#k
1.1: Great! Well, I'm gonna go play, then. Thanks a lot!

mob.0: You'll make those Lupins pay, right?
